title: Healthcare Workforce Burnout & Attrition Early Warning

blueprintSignals.name: Schedule churn
blueprintSignals.definition: share of shifts changed within 72 hours at unit level
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use schedule snapshots prior to the outcome window

blueprintSignals.name: Overtime load
blueprintSignals.definition: unit mean and tail of overtime hours per head

blueprintSignals.name: Vacancy burden
blueprintSignals.definition: open positions relative to budgeted FTE

blueprintSignals.name: Consecutive-shift pressure
blueprintSignals.definition: share of staff on long runs of consecutive shifts in the unit

engineFeatures.meaning: the cohort the subject joined, used for the time-based split

label: For "Healthcare Workforce Burnout & Attrition Early Warning": Identify aggregate working conditions associated with elevated burnout, absence or voluntary attrition risk at team and unit level so leaders can improve those conditions, never to score or manage individuals. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Evaluating on a random split of employees rather than by period.
